import json

content = read_file('/Users/bakulbadwal/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p12-json-top-customer/orders_export.json')
# Find the start of JSON content
json_start = content.find('{')
json_content = content[json_start:]
data = json.loads(json_content)

# Calculate total spent per customer for shipped orders
customer_totals = {}

for order in data['orders']:
    if order['status'] == 'shipped':
        customer = order['customer']
        name = f"{customer['first']} {customer['last']}"
        
        order_total = sum(item['qty'] * item['unit_price'] for item in order['items'])
        
        if name in customer_totals:
            customer_totals[name] += order_total
        else:
            customer_totals[name] = order_total

# Print all customer totals
for name, total in sorted(customer_totals.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True):
    print(f"{name}: {total:.2f}")

# Find the customer with the highest total
top_customer = max(customer_totals, key=customer_totals.get)
print(f"\nTop customer: {top_customer} with {customer_totals[top_customer]:.2f}")
